question: What state of the yogin is affirmed and what means of attainment is explicitly negated?
premises: The yogin becomes one of upward semen.
The yogin is not so by hand.
The claim is addressed to the beloved.
inference: Attainment of the upward-semen state belongs to the yogin, but not by manual means.
uncertainties: Token 'karata(?' is partially unclear in the received text and is transcribed exactly as given.
plain_english: O beloved, the yogin becomes one whose semen flows upward; the yogin is not so by hand.
